newsitem.title: USA: Capstar buys 20 radio stations for $60 million.
newsitem.headline: Capstar buys 20 radio stations for $60 million.

text.p: Capstar Broadcasting Partners, investors in radio companies, said Tuesday they signed definitive agreements to buy 20 radio stations in mid-sized markets in a deal valued at $60 million.
Capstar has acquired or agreed to buy 120 mid-sized stations in deals valued at some $600 million since it was formed last May by the private investment firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc.

The latest acquisitions are the Madison Radio Group, which has 4 FM and 2 AM stations in Madison, Wis.; Commonwealth Broadcasting of Arizona, L.L.C., which owns 2 FM stations and 1 AM station in Yuma, Ariz.; Cavalier Communications, L.P., with 4 FM stations and 1 AM station in the Roanoke and Lynchburg, Va.; and COMCO Broadcasting Inc., which owns 4 FM and 2 AM stations in the Anchorage and Fairbanks, Alaska.
